yogas.name: Gajakesari Yoga
yogas.description: Jupiter in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th, or 10th) from the Moon, associated with wisdom, reputation, and lasting prosperity.
evidence: Jupiter is 4 signs from the Moon (kendra positions: 1, 4, 7, 10).

yogas.name: Budhaditya Yoga
yogas.description: Sun and Mercury conjunct in one sign, associated with intelligence, communication skill, and administrative ability.

yogas.name: Raj Yoga (Kendra-Trikona)
yogas.description: Lord of a kendra and lord of a trikona conjoined or the same planet rules both; one of the most auspicious combinations indicating power, success, and recognition.
evidence: Lord of 10th (kendra) and lord of 1th (trikona): jupiter.

yogas.name: Vipreet Raj Yoga
yogas.description: Lord of a dusthana (6th, 8th, or 12th) placed in another dusthana; turns adversity into advantage - obstacles become sources of unexpected gain.
evidence: No dusthana lord is placed in another dusthana.

yogas.name: Neecha Bhanga Raj Yoga
yogas.description: A debilitated planet whose weakness is cancelled by specific conditions (strong dispositor, etc.); transforms a difficult placement into a source of great strength.
evidence: Debilitated planet(s): mars but no cancellation conditions met.

yogas.name: Adhi Yoga
yogas.description: Natural benefics occupy the 6th, 7th, and 8th from the Moon; indicates high status, authority, and victory over adversaries.
evidence: 2 benefic(s) in the 6th/7th/8th houses from Moon.

yogas.name: Amala Yoga
yogas.description: A natural benefic in the 10th house from lagna or Moon; indicates an unblemished reputation, philanthropy, and lasting fame.
evidence: No natural benefic in the 10th house.

yogas.name: Saraswati Yoga
yogas.description: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury all in kendras, trikonas, or the 2nd house with Jupiter dignified; confers learning, eloquence, mastery of arts and sciences.

yogas.name: Lakshmi Yoga
yogas.description: Lord of the 9th house placed in a kendra in its own, exalted, or moolatrikona sign; indicates immense wealth, fortune, and divine grace.
evidence: Lord of 9th is neither in a kendra nor strong.

yogas.name: Chandra-Mangal Yoga
yogas.description: Moon and Mars in conjunction or mutual opposition, associated with earning drive and material enterprise.
evidence: Mars is 12 signs from the Moon.

yogas.name: Dhana Yoga
yogas.description: Lord of the 2nd house conjoined with or in mutual aspect with the lord of the 11th; indicates wealth accumulation and strong financial gains.
evidence: No conjunction or mutual aspect between lords of 2nd and 11th.

yogas.name: Ruchaka Yoga (Mars Mahapurusha)
yogas.description: mars in its own or exaltation sign placed in a kendra from the lagna.
evidence: mars occupies house 5 from the lagna.

yogas.name: Bhadra Yoga (Mercury Mahapurusha)
yogas.description: mercury in its own or exaltation sign placed in a kendra from the lagna.
evidence: mercury occupies house 12 from the lagna.

yogas.name: Hamsa Yoga (Jupiter Mahapurusha)
yogas.description: jupiter in its own or exaltation sign placed in a kendra from the lagna.
evidence: jupiter occupies house 9 from the lagna.

yogas.name: Malavya Yoga (Venus Mahapurusha)
yogas.description: venus in its own or exaltation sign placed in a kendra from the lagna.
evidence: venus occupies house 11 from the lagna.

yogas.name: Sasa Yoga (Saturn Mahapurusha)
yogas.description: saturn in its own or exaltation sign placed in a kendra from the lagna.
evidence: saturn occupies house 12 from the lagna.

yogas.name: Sunapha Yoga
yogas.description: A planet in the 2nd house from the Moon; indicates self-made wealth, good intellect, and prosperity through one's own efforts.
evidence: No qualifying planet in the 2nd from Moon.

yogas.name: Anapha Yoga
yogas.description: A planet in the 12th house from the Moon; indicates good health, virtue, and comfortable living.

yogas.name: Durudhara Yoga
yogas.description: Planets flanking the Moon on both sides (2nd and 12th from it); indicates wealth, generosity, and a life of comforts.

yogas.name: Voshi Yoga
yogas.description: A planet in the 2nd house from the Sun; indicates eloquence, learning, and charitable disposition.
evidence: No qualifying planet in the 2nd from Sun.

yogas.name: Veshi Yoga
yogas.description: A planet in the 12th house from the Sun; indicates authority, power, and steady temperament.
evidence: mercury, saturn in the 12th from Sun (Aquarius).

yogas.name: Ubhayachari Yoga
yogas.description: Planets flanking the Sun on both sides (2nd and 12th); indicates a powerful, kingly personality with commanding presence.

yogas.name: Manglik Dosha (Kuja Dosha)
yogas.description: Mars in houses 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 from the lagna; traditionally assessed for marital compatibility. Cancellation conditions may mitigate the effect.

yogas.name: Guru Chandal Yoga
yogas.description: Jupiter conjoined with Rahu in the same sign; may indicate unconventional wisdom, disrupted advice from teachers, or unorthodox spiritual leanings.

yogas.name: Pitra Dosha
yogas.description: Sun conjunct Rahu or Ketu; indicates ancestral karmic debts that may manifest as obstacles or delayed results in life.
evidence: Sun is not conjunct either node.

yogas.name: Grahan Yoga
yogas.description: A luminary (Sun or Moon) conjoined with a node (Rahu or Ketu); indicates karmic intensity around the luminary's significations - identity (Sun) or mind/emotions (Moon).
evidence: Neither luminary is conjunct a node.

yogas.name: Kemadruma Yoga
yogas.description: No planet (excluding Sun, Rahu, Ketu) conjoins the Moon or occupies the 2nd or 12th from it; classically linked to isolation and fluctuating fortunes.
evidence: Supporting planets around the Moon: mars.

yogas.name: Kaal Sarp Yoga
yogas.description: All seven classical planets hemmed on one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis; traditionally read as concentrated karmic intensity.
evidence: Rahu at 194.11 deg, Ketu at 14.11 deg.
Planets occupy both sides of the nodal axis.

upay.title: Debt to father (first degree): jupiter in house 9
upay.action: Every blood relative contributes one rupee and the sum is given at a temple on one day; also honour a peepal tree or shrine within 16 paces of the house exit on the left.
upay.why: jupiter sits in house 9 with mercury, which the book lists as the pattern for this debt.

upay.title: Repair mercury (spoils jupiter in house 9)
upay.action: Do a separate remedy for mercury after the debt remedy is finished. Keep the planet's article on the roof.
upay.why: The book asks for two remedies in a debt: the damaged planet and the planet that damages it, run one after the other.

delivery.method: Keep the planet's article on the roof.

oneAtATime.rule: Run only one remedy at a time. Observe it for 40 or 43 consecutive days (or weeks, per the book), leave a gap of a few days, then start the next. Running two at once is said to nullify both.
